verdict.rationale: Fellow has no headless binary or CLI, but its own Developer API supports non-interactive automation: API-key authentication, REST endpoints for listing, writing and uploading, background processing with status polling, and webhooks, so scripts or CI jobs can drive it without the UI. missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI-specific documentation or examples, a sandbox or test workspace, a published OpenAPI spec at a stable vendor path, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
